title: An 18-game NFL season is coming: Here's how the league can keep the balance right

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: An 18-game NFL season is coming: Here's how the league can keep the balance right
sources.description: As the NFL moves toward an 18-game season in the next few years, the NBA's tanking-shaped stretch run offers a recent example of what can happen late in long seasons -- and what the league may need to manage to keep games competitive
